name: Knight’s Etiquette
text:
Attack / Move · Your Turn
Roll a 2-dice Attack against one target and move one space, once each in either order.

name: Pride & Roses
text:
★ Pride & Roses           Roses blooming in full glory…
Type      Attack / Gambit          Timing Your Turn
          Roll a [2 dice Attack] against 1 target, then roll another [2
Effect    dice Attack] against 1 target. Afterward, you recover 2
          Endurance.
          A skill that executes a graceful, high-speed barrage of attacks
Flavor
          reminiscent of a blossoming rose.

name: Purifying Rose
text:
Purifying Rose         Be dyed in pure love…
Type      Gambit / Support       Timing Your Turn
          Restore [1 die] Endurance to all targets of your choice in
Effect    your Garden. Roll the die once, applying the same result to
          all chosen.
          The roses bloom all around, their petals dancing gracefully,
Flavor
          and their fragrance gently heals damaged Stellar Dresses.

name: Duel
text:
Duel     Honorable single combat…
Type      Move / Gambit            Timing Your Turn
          If you are a Stellar Knight, select 1 Enemy. If you are an
          Enemy, select 1 Stellar Knight. Place yourself and the chosen
          character in a Garden with no other characters present.
Effect
          This action is not considered movement (it is unaffected by
          skills referencing the number of spaces moved or even the
          act of moving itself!).
Flavor    Let’s move this to a fitting stage, shall we? Follow me.

name: Royal Rose Dress
text:
Royal Rose Dress           Flower in abundance, in your Knight's favor…
Type      Gambit / Support        Timing Your Turn / Passive
          Effect 1: During your turn, you may remove 1 Set die from
          this skill to allow another character to roll a [1 dice Charge
          check] and restore 2 Endurance.
          Effect 2: You passively gain the following effects depending
Effect
          on the number of Set dice placed on this skill:
          0 dice → No effect
          1+ dice → You lose -1 Defense, but gain +1 dice rolled to all
          [Attack checks] you perform.
          Rose petals dance around you gracefully, adorning you like
Flavor
          an exquisite dress.

name: Aquilegia: The Fool
text:
★ Aquilegia: The Fool           Blade of the joker…
Type     Attack                  Timing Your Turn
         Roll a [(3 + Round count) dice Attack] against 1 target.
Effect
         Afterwards, you lose [Round count] Endurance.
         A blade swung with reckless abandon. A straightforward
Flavor
         strike that seeks victory, heedless of your own well-being.

name: Aquilegia: The Remnant
text:
Aquilegia: The Remnant              Roar of the fool…
                                         Just after your Endurance
Type     Gambit                   Timing
                                         drops to 1~4
         Remove all Set dice from this skill to activate. You recover
Effect
         [3 + Set dice removed] Endurance.
         The numerous wounds carved into your pride serve only to
Flavor
         strengthen your resolve toward victory.

name: Win, no matter what!!
text:
Win, no matter what!!           The Columbine's flower language is...
Type     Move / Attack           Timing Your Turn
         You move 1~2 spaces, your choice. Then, roll a [5 + (spaces
Effect   moved) dice Attack check] against 1 target. Afterward, you
         take [2 + spaces moved] damage.
         Even if your body breaks, you shall not yield this victory.
Flavor
         Deliver a killing blow at full speed.

name: System: Aquilegia
text:
System: Aquilegia         Even if this body scatters like petals…
                                           Just after your Endurance
Type     Gambit                   Timing
                                           hits 0
         Remove all Set dice from this skill to activate. You
         immediately recover 5 Endurance. Then, inflict [Set dice
Effect
         removed] damage on 1 target. This skill can only be used
         once per Stellar Battle.
         You refuse to lose here. You refuse to be scattered to the
Flavor
         wind. You pursue victory with insatiable resolve.

name: Fortress Cosmos
text:
★ Fortress Cosmos           The Bastion of Purity…
                                           Just after dice are rolled for
Type     Gambit / Support         Timing
                                           an Attack check
         Increase the Defense of 1 target by [Round count] against
Effect   this Attack check only. This skill can be used once per check,
         and may be declared after seeing the check's result.
         Without protecting those you must, harmony cannot exist.
Flavor
         Dancing cosmos flowers form a shield to protect your allies.

name: Cosmos Order
text:
Cosmos Order        A World in Perfect Harmony…
Type     Attack / Gambit         Timing Your Turn
         Roll a [3 dice Attack] against 1 target. If the Attack deals
Effect   damage, the target must choose and remove 1 of their Set
         dice.
         You are law, you are order. Stand tall, take up your sword.
Flavor
         None can hinder your advance.

name: Cosmos: Over the Pain
text:
Cosmos: Over the Pain            The Sky Beyond Pain…
Type     Gambit / Support       Timing Your Turn
         You lose [Round count] Endurance. Then, restore [3 + Round
Effect   count] Endurance to all targets of your choice (excluding
         yourself) in your Garden and adjacent Gardens.
         What spills from your fingertips isn't blood. Blossoming
Flavor
         cosmos flowers take to the air, mending your allies' wounds.

name: Around the Cosmos
text:
Around the Cosmos           Race Across the Universe…
Type     Move / Support          Timing Your Turn
         All willing targets you choose may each move 1 space. Each
Effect
         character determines their own destination.
         Your command guides your comrades, much like a conductor
Flavor
         leading an orchestra.

name: Calystegia Sphere
text:
★ Calystegia Sphere            Dancing, Swirling Morning Glory Petals…
Type     Defense / Support       Timing Just before an Attack check
         During the upcoming Attack, increase the Defense of all
Effect   characters in your Garden and adjacent Gardens by [Round
         count].
         Morning Glories whirl around, deceiving foes and adorning
Flavor
         knights, a dazzling spectacle on the battlefield.

name: Dance in the Calystegia
text:
Dance in the Calystegia            Bloom on the Battlefield…
Type     Attack / Gambit          Timing Your Turn
         Roll a [(2 + Round count) dice Attack] against 1 target.
Effect   Afterward, you recover [the # of characters in your Garden]
         Endurance.
         A Morning Glory's battle is never fought alone. On a more
Flavor   tangled battlefield, the strength of others paints your petals
         even brighter.

name: Avandner
text:
Avandner      The Flower of Bonds, Dancing Across the Frontline…
Type     Attack / Move           Timing Your Turn
         Roll a [1 dice Attack] against 1 target, then move yourself 1
Effect   space. Afterward, roll another [1 dice Attack] against 1
         target, and move yourself 1 space again.
Flavor   Lightly, deftly, you dash across the battlefield.

name: System: Calystegia
text:
System: Calystegia          To Share the Next Moment with You…
                                          Just after your Endurance
Type     Gambit                    Timing
                                          hits 0
         Remove all Set dice from this skill to activate. You
         immediately recover 5 Endurance, and restore [# of Set dice
Effect
         removed] Endurance to another character. This skill can be
         used only once per Stellar Battle.
         Driven by the unyielding will not to fall here, for another's
Flavor
         sake, your Stella Dress shines anew.

name: Anemone's Resolve
text:
★ Anemone's Resolve             Light a Fire in Fading Hope…
Type     Attack                  Timing Your Turn
         Roll a [(your location's Garden #) dice Attack] against 1
Effect   target. Then, you take [half (rounded down) the damage
         dealt by this Attack] damage.
         You strike with a resolve to grant your wish, even if it means
Flavor   defeating everyone else. An attack fueled by unwavering
         determination.

name: Wish Bringer
text:
Wish Bringer       Bearer of Hope…
Type     Gambit / Support           Timing Just before an Attack check
         During the upcoming Attack, all characters' Defenses
Effect
         changes to [their location's Garden #].
         All hopes are fleeting, but not gone. A flurry of petals covers
Flavor   the battlefield, a skill that support and hinders both offense
         and defense in equal measure.

name: Phantom Pain
text:
Phantom Pain        Small Aches and Pains…
Type     Move / Attack             Timing Your Turn
         Move yourself 1 space. Then, roll a [1 + (the # of characters
Effect
         in your Garden) dice Attack] against 1 target.
         A skill that lets you strengthen your attack with the help of
Flavor   allies, or by harnessing your enemy’s power.
           "I am no longer alone."

name: Anemone Dress
text:
Anemone Dress          Ephemeral Dreams, My Only Color…
Type     Defense / Support       Timing Just before an Attack check
         During the upcoming Attack, increase 1 character’s Defense
Effect   by [Round count]. This effect does not stack if used on the
         same character multiple times.
         You are adorned in an Anemone Dress. Its beauty becomes
Flavor
         your shield, protecting both you and your companions.

name: The Shores of Victory & Defeat
text:
★ The Shores of Victory & Defeat
Type     Gambit / Support        Timing Your Turn
         Choose one of the following effects:
         "Restore [Round count] Endurance to all characters in odd-
         numbered Gardens, and deal [Round count] damage to all
Effect   characters in even-numbered Gardens."
         OR "Restore [Round count] Endurance to all characters in
         even-numbered Gardens, and deal [Round count] damage to
         all characters in odd-numbered Gardens."
         Victory and defeat, two sides of the same coin. Amid the
Flavor
         blooming Spider Lilies, to whom will they smile?

name: The Near & Far Shores
text:
The Near & Far Shores
Type     Gambit / Support        Timing Your Turn
         All characters in your Garden (including you) recover [2 +
         Round count] Endurance. Then, deal [2 + Round count]
Effect   damage to all characters located in the Garden directly
         opposite yours. (Directly Opposite Gardens refer to
         arrangements like Garden 1 & 4, or 2 & 5!)
         If this place where Spider Lilies bloom is the near shore, then
Flavor
         let me scatter them wildly to the far shore as well.

name: Poisoned Flower of Grief
text:
Poisoned Flower of Grief
                                          Just after you take damage
Type     Gambit                   Timing
                                          from an Attack check
         When you take damage from an Attack, you deal the same
         amount of damage back to the character who made the
Effect
         Attack check. (This skill cannot be used against Attack
         checks made by the Stage itself.)
Flavor   Let those who harm you taste your pain.

name: Spider Lilies Beneath the Moonlight
text:
Spider Lilies Beneath the Moonlight
                                   When a Stage's Action Routine
Type     Gambit          Timing
                                   effect would activate
         The Stage Action for this turn, as indicated by the Omen,
Effect
         does not occur. You take [5 + Round count] damage.
         Spider Lilies bloom all around. The moon drifts overhead.
Flavor
         Your flower spreads, taking the stage.

name: Amaranthus Room
text:
★ Amaranthus Room               The Room of Origins…
Type     Gambit                  Timing Your Turn
         Select 2 numbers. For the remainder of this round, all rolled
         dice results showing your 1st selected number are changed
Effect
         to the 2nd selected number. This effect applies to all
         characters and the Stage.
         Your Amaranthus overtakes part of the stage. You won't allow
Flavor
         others to do as they please.

name: Betrayal's Amaranthus
text:
Betrayal's Amaranthus             Betrayal's Unwithering Flower…
Type     Attack                  Timing Your Turn
         Roll a [2 dice Attack] against yourself or a willing target. (If
Effect   the Attack is not rolled, the following effect is negated.)
         Afterward, roll a [5 dice Attack] against 1 other target.
Flavor   A savage blade strikes, harming even your allies.

name: Eternity's Amaranthus
text:
Eternity's Amaranthus             Eternity's Unwithering Flower…
                                            Just after your Endurance
Type     Gambit                   Timing
                                            hits 0
         Remove all Set dice from this skill to activate. You
Effect   immediately recover [5 + Set dice removed] Endurance. This
         skill can only be used once per Stellar Battle.
         I have no intention of falling here. So, let us continue the
Flavor
         fight a little longer.

name: Unlimited Libra
text:
Unlimited Libra        The Library of Life…
                                           Just after another character
Type     Gambit / Support         Timing
                                           takes damage
         The character who took damage immediately rolls a
Effect   [(Round count) dice Charge check]. This skill can only be
         used once per character per round.
         A skill that shares your strength with the wounded. You will
Flavor
         carve the path for another's survival.

name: Night Runner
text:
★ Night Runner          Dash Through the Night…
Type     Move / Support         Timing Your Turn
         You, and 1 willing target of your choice in your Garden,
Effect
         move together to another Garden within 1 space.
         Blending into the shadows, you swiftly slip past everyone's
Flavor
         gaze. You might as well help an ally along the way.

name: Midnight Vamp
text:
★ Midnight Vamp           Vampire of the dark…
Type     Attack                 Timing Your Turn
         You recover 2 Endurance. Then, roll a [3 dice Attack]
Effect
         against 1 target.
         Lurking in the darkness, you slice through foes like the
Flavor
         vampires of myth.

name: Corrupt Touch
text:
Corrupt Touch        Corruption's black temptation…
Type     Attack / Gambit         Timing Your Turn
         Move a target 1 space. Then, roll a [2 dice Attack] against
Effect
         them. Afterward, you recover [damage dealt] Endurance.
         Like a monster out of a story, your attack drains an enemy's
Flavor
         vitality.

name: Black Avenger
text:
Black Avenger        Behold the black shadow at your back…
Type     Gambit / Attack         Timing Just after you take damage
         Deal [the damage taken] damage to the character who
Effect   inflicted it upon you. (This skill cannot be used against
         Attacks made by the Stage itself.)
Flavor   You took that attack on purpose.

name: Black Flowers Zenith
text:
Black Flowers Zenith           The pinnacle of black petals…
                                          Just before someone else
Type     Gambit / Support        Timing
                                          takes damage
         Reduce the damage received by another character by half
Effect
         (rounded down).
         A storm of black petals descends from the sky, confusing
Flavor
         enemy attacks and protecting your allies.

name: Floral Ring
text:
★ Floral Ring       Scarlet Wreath of Scattered Embers…
Type     Gambit                  Timing Your Turn
         Gain 1 "Flame Counter." You can have multiple Counters.
Effect   Flame Counter: Each time you take damage, you may deal 1
         damage to the character damaging you.
         Fiery crystals whirl around you, as if with a mind of their
Flavor
         own; ready to burn any who would do you harm.

name: Red Flowers’ Gloria
text:
Red Flowers’ Gloria          Glory of the Red Flower…
Type     Attack / Gambit         Timing Your Turn
         Roll a [3 dice Attack] against 1 target. During this Attack,
Effect
         their Defense is reduced by 1.
         Red petals whirl in the air. None can stand in the way of your
Flavor
         assault.

name: Burn with Fire
text:
Burn with Fire       Burn with Passion…
 Type    Attack                  Timing Your Turn
Effect   Roll a [4 dice Attack] against 1 target.
Flavor   Let your emotions ignite. Strike as your heart desires.

name: Dance with Heat
text:
Dance with Heat         Dance with Passion…
Type     Gambit                 Timing Just after someone moves
         Deal [spaces moved] damage to the character who just
Effect
         moved.
         Scorch their shoes and have them dance; covering the stage in
Flavor
         flames.

name: Rewrite Your Story
text:
★ Rewrite Your Story              You Think That's Good Enough?…
Type     Gambit / Support       Timing Just before an Attack check
         During the upcoming Attack check (including your own),
Effect
         reduce the Defense of 1 target by 1.
         Your words or actions draw attention and create an opening;
Flavor
         and exploit that moment.

name: Mind Over Matter
text:
Mind Over Matter           Will of the Yellow Flower…
Type     Gambit / Support         Timing Your turn
         1 target rolls a [2 dice Charge check] and recovers 2
Effect   Endurance. Then you take 2 damage. This skill can only be
         used once per round on the same target.
         A will so strong it manifests as petals; this skill helps others
Flavor
         act through sheer force of mind.

name: Yellow Queen
text:
Yellow Queen         The Queen in Yellow…
Type     Gambit / Defense        Timing Your turn
         For the rest of this round, reduce the number of dice rolled
         for any Attack check targeting any willing targets of your
Effect
         choice other than yourself within your Garden by 1. This
         effect can stack up to [Round count] times.
         No one acts without your leave in your domain. Petals of
Flavor
         yellow dance to protect those within.

name: Yes, My Lady
text:
Yes, My Lady        Lady of the Battlefield…
Type     Move / Support         Timing Your turn
Effect   Swap places with 1 willing target of your choice.
         Stand back. —Yes, my lady.
Flavor   Out of the way. —Yes, my lady.
         Go. —Yes, my lady.

name: Whirlpool of Thought
text:
★ Whirlpool of Thought             Spinning Turning Whirling…
Type     Gambit                Timing Just after someone rolls dice
         Choose 1 target; re-roll 1~2 of the dice they just rolled (you
Effect   can use this effect on any dice roll; not just Attack or
         Charge checks!).
         A skill for aiding or hindering others through strategy and
Flavor
         positioning.

name: Wind Signpost
text:
Wind Signpost         Guiding Winds…
Type     Gambit / Support        Timing Your turn
         Place 1 willing target in your Garden. This does not count as
Effect   movement (it does not interact with skills referencing the
         number of spaces moved or the act of moving itself!).
         The wind pushes your allies, guiding them to advantageous
Flavor
         ground.

name: Deep Blue Blade
text:
Deep Blue Blade         Sword of the Deep Sea…
Type     Attack                   Timing Your turn
         Roll a [2 dice Attack] against 1 target. Then, if you are in
Effect
         Garden 3, roll an additional [3 dice Attack].
         A skill for striking from a position of advantage, born of
Flavor
         deeper cunning.

name: Deep Contemplation
text:
Deep Contemplation
Type     Gambit / Support         Timing Your turn
         All willing targets of your choice each roll a [1 die Charge
         check]. Then, if you are in Garden 1, all who rolled the
Effect
         Charge check recover [Round count] Endurance. This skill
         can only be used once per round.
         A flurry of blue petals sweeps through, granting your allies
Flavor
         even greater strength.

name: White Shield
text:
★ White Shield         Brilliant Shield…
Type     Defense / Support Timing Just before an Attack check
         Restore 1 Endurance to a character targeted by an Attack,
Effect
         and increase their Defense by 1 for the upcoming Attack.
         Shimmering white petals form a shield, protecting you from
Flavor
         harm.

name: Anthem of Eradication
text:
Anthem of Eradication
Type     Attack / Gambit       Timing Your turn
         Roll a [3 dice Attack] against 1 target. If you deal damage,
Effect
         the target rolls 1 fewer die on their next Attack.
Flavor   Before your sharp assault, none can escape annihilation.

name: Lightning Intercept
text:
Lightning Intercept           Faster Than Light…
                                         Just before an Attack check
Type     Gambit / Defense      Timing
                                         against you
         Deal [1 + Round count] damage to the character about to
Effect   attack you. For the upcoming Attack check, increase your
         Defense by [Round count].
         A skill to strike faster than your foe; nothing surpasses the
Flavor
         speed of light.

name: Flash Step
text:
Flash Step      White Streak Dash…
Type     Move                 Timing Your turn
Effect   You move 2~3 spaces.
         A skill to dash across the battlefield in an instant, as if you
Flavor
         were light itself.

name: Nine Liverary
text:
★ Nine Liverary         Nine Towers Aligned in the Dark of Night…
Type     Gambit / Support Timing Your turn
         All willing targets of your choice roll a [(Round count) dice
         Charge check]. Afterward, those who rolled the Charge
Effect
         check each take [Round count] damage. This skill can only
         be used once per round on the same character.
         Purple towers line the stage; granting greater power, in
Flavor
         exchange for a price.

name: Diaclock: The Purple
text:
Diaclock: The Purple           The Colors of Past and Future…
Type     Gambit                 Timing Your turn
         All willing targets of your choice may remove any amount of
Effect   Set dice. Those who remove at least 1 die recover [3 + Set
         dice removed] Endurance.
         As if time itself has stopped, all movement on the stage
Flavor   ceases. The swirling purple petals grant vitality at the cost of
         each person’s time.

name: Draco Grace Command
text:
Draco Grace Command               Command Both Stern and Elegant…
Type     Gambit              Timing Just after an Attack check
         Choose 1 die from an Attack check made by any character
Effect   and change it to any result. Then, you recover [6 - the new
         result] Endurance.
         Your poised, elegant command sometimes aids allies,
Flavor   sometimes hinders foes; yet always serves your own
         interests.

name: Purple Flower Dial
text:
Purple Flower Dial
Type     Move / Support       Timing Your turn
         All willing targets of your choice each move 1 space
Effect   clockwise. Those who move this way each recover [Round
         count] Endurance.
         Like the hands of a clock turning forward, your orders control
Flavor
         the battlefield.
